limitations: Landmark forms are original low-detail silhouette interpretations, not measured architectural replicas.
Fine façade ornament, text, and clock numerals are intentionally omitted at chess-piece scale.
No physical print, durability, fit-in-use, or human playtest result has been established.
No storage case is included; use a separate padded container for transport.
Side identity is geometric; actual piece colors may vary and do not change setup or play.
summary: A geometry-readable orthodox chess set that turns six Ho Chi Minh City landmarks into a complete 32-piece skyline, with round River and square Grid plinths distinguishing the two sides without relying on color.
title: Saigon Skyline Chess
what_arrives: 16 River pieces with round stepped plinths
16 Grid pieces with square stepped plinths
